Kit summary

Tide ImpactBasicExclusive Lv.2
Deals 280% DEF DMG to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to inflict [Wet II] for 2 turns.
Torrent Shield Lv.2When Sewell is under the [Way of Ocean] status, grants self 1 layer of [Wave Surge] each time he casts Shin · Tide Impact. If there are no less than 2 layers, the next Shin · Tide Impact will consume all layers of [Wave Surge] and increase its DMG dealt to 180% of the initial value. Meanwhile, the additional Piercing Rate will increase to 75%. [Wave Surge] will not be removed when the owner dies.
Power of TorrentActiveExclusive Lv.1
Enters the [Way of Ocean] status. When Sewell is under the [Way of Ocean] status, increases self DEF by 25% and reduces the Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG dealt to self by 30%.
Torrent Shield Lv.1Cleanses all debuffs from self when entering [Way of Ocean] by casting Power of Torrent. Meanwhile, increases the total HP loss needed to end [Way of Ocean] to 200% of the initial value.
Remarkable CouragePassive
Increases self Turn Meter by 5% for every 5% of Max HP lost.
Torrent TornadoActive
Deals 4 stages of 80% DEF DMG each to all enemies. The first stage has a 75% chance to reduce the targets' DEF by 60% for 2 turns. When Sewell is under [Way of Ocean] status, grants self 1 layer of [Tornado] for every 5% of Max HP lost. Each layer of [Tornado] increases the DMG dealt by Torrent Tornado by 5%. Sewell will withdraw from the [Way of Ocean] status and lose all layers of [Tornado] after casting Torrent Tornado.
Torrent BlissPassiveExclusive Lv.3
When Sewell is under the [Way of Ocean] status, grants self immunity to [Stun], [Hypnotize], and [Freeze]. Meanwhile Sewell can counterattack. Cannot be stacked with the buff [Counterattack]. [Way of Ocean] ends when 60% of Max HP is lost in total.
Torrent Shield Lv.3When Sewell is under the [Way of Ocean] status, grants self 1 layer of [Torrent] at the beginning of each turn or when self loses 5% of Max HP in total each time. Each layer of [Torrent] increases self Basic Attack DMG by 3%, up to 20 layers and will not be removed when the buff owner dies or at the wave transition.
Shin · Tide ImpactBasicExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3

Meanwhile, the additional Piercing Rate will increase to 75%. [Wave Surge] will not be removed when the owner dies.
